_about: The 12 wishes for Dimas in the promo video (promo/README.md). Made with edge-tts by promo/make-voices.py. In the video, 'heard' marks the voices tapped and heard (in this order); the rest only light a candle. 'mood' (if set) is the app's voice mood (voicefx.js MOODS), played in the app and rendered into the soundtrack; 'say' (if set) is what the TTS speaks, with fewer pauses; 'text' is the caption.

voices.name: Sari
voices.text: Dimas! Selamat ulang tahun, semoga semua mimpimu tercapai.

voices.text: Dim, HBD bro! Traktir jangan lupa ya!
